name: Pirate's Curse

specialAbility.name: Cannon Fire
specialAbility.description: Pirate's Curse loads up its twin pirate cannons and blasts a massive cannonball right at the enemy!

lore: Legends say Pirate's Curse was built from the wreckage of a haunted pirate ship that washed ashore during a hurricane! It has a skull and crossbones on the hood, real cannons on the sides, and a tattered pirate flag on top. When those cannons fire, BOOM — the enemy goes flying!
